description: CIDR Merge and Aggregate — Collapse a list of IPv4/IPv6 addresses, CIDRs and start-end ranges into the smallest exact CIDR set, offline. cidrs= is separated by commas, spaces, | or newlines (up to 5000 entries). Optional exclude= cuts ranges out (holes split blocks) and format=json|plain|nginx_deny|nginx_allow|iptables|apache_deny returns ready-to-paste lines in text. Merges duplicates, overlaps and adjacent blocks, normalizes host bits (10.0.0.5/24 to 10.0.0.0/24), reports invalid entries, exact address counts, ranges and the reduction percentage. Pairs with threat/blocklist and firewall audits. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_cidr_merge
